cannot_preserve: Every value crosses AUIF as text (canonical type STRING) and is given its APG type (cents, date, decimal, enum, integer) by the unchanged APG mapping rules after delivery. AUIF has no calendar-date type (TIMESTAMP needs a time of day), and an AUIF INTEGER or DECIMAL column would make AUIF's file importer refuse a whole page for one bad cell where APG refuses or holds only that row; so the APG type is recorded in each attribute's constraints (apg_type) and enforced by APG, not by AUIF.

The record's row number is its position in the delivery batch (blank rows skipped as M3 does), not a line of a file; the file name and file hash that M3 stores are replaced by the AUIF lineage (integration, source record, translation pack and hash, canonical id, observation, manifest).

A column that is not in the template is not carried: any change to the columns is schema drift for AUIF and the assessment cannot proceed until the pack is revalidated (M3 would accept an extra column and keep its text).
mapping_template_status: draft - unverified against any real export
missing_or_conflicting: A field absent from the delivered object: the batch is not applied and the assessment cannot proceed (MISSING_FIELD).
A value of the wrong canonical type (not text): AUIF marks the object TRANSLATION_INVALID; the batch is not applied (TRANSLATION_INVALID).

A blank value: as M3 - a blank required field rejects the row (and the assessment cannot proceed: ROW_REJECTED); a blank optional field is UNKNOWN, never zero: a material field is held (MATERIAL_VALUE_UNKNOWN), a field the intake policy tolerates is a warning (VALUE_MISSING), any other is held (CRITICAL_VALUE_MISSING).

A value APG cannot parse (cents with a decimal point, a date not written as the template says, an unknown enum value): a required field rejects the row; an optional field is held as INVALID_VALUE; either way the assessment cannot proceed (ROW_REJECTED / VALUE_INVALID).

The same key delivered again with the same content: a duplicate delivery, no second effect.  A higher declared source revision: a new revision.  A lower one: a stale delivery, recorded and not applied (the assessment cannot proceed: STALE_DELIVERY).  Different content with no way to order the versions: a quarantined conflict holding every version (the existing M3 contract; shown as an exclusion).
Two sources disagreeing on a field the source-authority register governs: decided by the register in reconciliation (apg/ingest/reconcile.py), never by arrival order.
A mapping AUIF marks AMBIGUOUS, or a field the pack does not map: the object is not delivered (AMBIGUOUS / TRANSLATION_INVALID) and the assessment cannot proceed.
